# Mastery Nexus

Mastery Nexus is a UK-focused online career training brand for aspiring and early-career data analysts.

## Primary programme
- 12-Week Data Analytics + AI Career Accelerator
- Live mentor-led online delivery
- Core skills: Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, pandas, statistics, Git/GitHub, applied generative AI
- Starts with an evidence-based skill-gap assessment
- Includes portfolio projects and UK-focused career preparation
- Career support includes CV/LinkedIn, portfolio review, mock interviews, job-search strategy and placement guidance under programme terms

## Key pages
- /course — programme curriculum and 12-week roadmap
- /personalised-learning — skill-gap assessment and adaptive learning method
- /career-support — career and placement support process
- /blog — source-aware career and skills guides
- /contact — free skill-gap assessment request

## Important clarification
Mastery Nexus does not state that every learner will secure a job within 12 weeks. Any placement guarantee, if offered to a specific cohort, is subject to a written agreement and eligibility conditions.
